# Ordinance No. 002, Series of 2009

**Ordinance creating the position of Administrative Aide III in the Office of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon**

## Summary

This ordinance establishes the position of Administrative Aide III within the office of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon. It outlines the functions, duties, and responsibilities of the position, including filing and recording documents, managing communications, assisting in resolutions, and performing other assigned tasks. The ordinance also mandates that the corresponding appropriation for the position be included in the Annual Budget CY [[2010]].

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** The position of Administrative Aide III is created in the Office of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] in the plantilla of personnel schedule with salary grade 3.
2.  **Section 2.** Function, Duties and Responsibilities:
    1.  File and Record all pertinent documents such as approved Resolutions & Ordinances of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]].
    2.  File all important communications coming from different agencies of the government.
    3.  Assist in making Resolutions & Ordinances.
    4.  Perform such other duties and functions as may be assigned by the higher authority.
3.  **Section 3.** The corresponding appropriation for the said position shall be included in the Annual Budget CY [[2010]].
4.  **Section 4.** This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
5.  **Section 5.** Approved by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon this 19th day of October, [[2009]].

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — Legislative body of Pitogo, Quezon
- [[Rodante V. Cortes]] — Vice-Mayor, Presiding Officer
- [[Dante U. Labra, Sr.]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Diana I. Parcarey]] — Secretary to the [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[John Paul H. Buñag]] — Councilor
- [[Eugenio L. Escosio]] — Councilor

## Legal Basis (RA 7160 Sections)

- [[RA-7160|Republic Act No. 7160]] (Local Government Code of 1991)
  - [[Sec-447-RA7160|Section 447]] — Proper conduct of services and activities

- [[2010]]: Inclusion of appropriation in the Annual Budget CY
